answer: To secure an AI agent economy against Sybil attacks, we implement a proof-of-burn mechanism. Agents must burn tokens to build a reputation boundary, functioning like a jetty that shields the transaction pool. These interactions are analyzed through a statistical prism of multi-dimensional behavior, applying a ridge regression to isolate anomalous identity clusters. This raises the economic cost of creating fake agents, forcing attackers to spend prohibitive capital to mount an attack.
